case_number: Criminal Appeal No. [number] of 2025; SLP (Crl.) No. 2345 of 2024

parties.petitioner: INOX Air Products Limited (Now known as INOX Air Products Private Limited) and Pavan Kumar Jain

summary: Drugs and Cosmetics Act violation; sale of Nitrous Oxide I.P. to unlicensed entity; interpretation of 'manufacture'; distinction between wholesale sale vs. manufacturing; no specific role for Managing Director; quashing of proceedings under Section 482 CrPC; order of magistrates non-speaking; quashing required under Pepsi Foods precedent.
final_judgment: Appellants' plea allowed; High Court judgment dismissing quashing under Section 482 CrPC set aside; proceedings against appellants quashed.
